resources.string: "Choose how long to keep detailed history and daily statistics. The current profile and latest list baseline stay available. Cleanup runs once a day while the app is in use."

"Archives older than the selected period will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone. Exported files must be deleted separately. Latest comparison baselines and dates that prevent erased history from returning are retained."
"Some archives could not be cleaned up. Preferences were saved; retry from Data retention."

"History, daily statistics, photo archives, notifications, notes and lists owned by @%1$s will be deleted. Membership in other accounts’ lists and exported files are excluded. Nothing changes on Instagram."
